meta.title: For a mixed PR, a user who matches any one item is shown

steps.note: Enable the required team-category filtering configuration for the case.
Stay on the Open PR tab where PR-3 can be located.

args.goal: Search for PR-3, show its two line items, select only the ENGG STORE item, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, and scroll through the Search a user list to the end while keeping the assignee picker open

steps.note: Perform the item-specific selection and open and inspect the complete assignee list.
Verify that the buyer matching the FRUITS item is available for assignment.
Verify that the buyer matching the ENGG STORE item is available for assignment.
